FUNCTION validate_sch_test_and_can_tsts RETURN varchar2 IS
--RP 10132018
 v_dummy varchar2(100);

 v_rest_test_id varchar2(100) := :VALID_SERIES_TEST_CONFIG.CANCEL_TEST;

 v_first_comma number := 1;
 v_string varchar2(100);
 v_cntr NUMBER := 0;
 l_prev_val varchar2(100);
 
 cursor c_sch_string is
 select regexp_substr(:VALID_SERIES_TEST_CONFIG.SCHEDULE_TEST,'[^,]+', 1, level) strings from dual
 connect by regexp_substr(:VALID_SERIES_TEST_CONFIG.SCHEDULE_TEST, '[^,]+', 1, level) is not null
 order by 1; 
 cursor c_can_string is
 select regexp_substr(:VALID_SERIES_TEST_CONFIG.CANCEL_TEST,'[^,]+', 1, level) strings from dual
 connect by regexp_substr(:VALID_SERIES_TEST_CONFIG.CANCEL_TEST, '[^,]+', 1, level) is not null
 order by 1; 
begin
 if LENGTH(:VALID_SERIES_TEST_CONFIG.SCHEDULE_TEST) > 1 and LENGTH(:VALID_SERIES_TEST_CONFIG.CANCEL_TEST) > 1 then
 begin
 for i in c_sch_string loop
 -- message(' Strings 1 : '||i.strings);
 v_string := i.strings;
 for j in c_can_string loop
 --message(' Strings 2 : '||j.strings);
 if v_string = j.strings then
 v_result_match := 1;
 --return 'Y';
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop; 
 if v_result_match = 1 then
 return 'Y';
 exit;
 end if; 
 end loop;
 if v_result_match <> 1 then
 return 'N';
 end if; 
 end;
 else
 return 'N';
 end if;
exception
 when others then
 return 'N';
end;
